status: exploratory descriptive falsification and conditional simulation; no causal claim
unit: slope change in CN minus mean-country log(1+family count) per +10 percentage points of pre-B
B_role: pre-period effect modifier, not a policy-assigned treatment dose

ALL.condition: observed = target + bias; fixed reported B; |bias| <= kappa, no sampling uncertainty

APP.condition: observed = target + bias; fixed reported B; |bias| <= kappa, no sampling uncertainty

assumptions.window_geometry: 28 simulated months: baseline 0:12; omitted gap 12:23; post 23:28
assumptions.scope: conditional, fixed-B/fixed-IPC, stationary residual simulation; not policy-effect power or an inferential correction
assumptions.known_failures_excluded: nonstationary breaks, uncertain B, historical taxonomy, selection, policy overlap, new China-specific shock, unknown patent decision lag

cross_definition_measurement_sensitivity.interpretation: Changing ALL to APP changes the B definition, not an estimated sampling distribution of the true B.
